Iran Releases Video of Mojtaba Khamenei Amid Health Rumors

Iranian media released an undated video of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei amidst widespread speculation about his deteriorating health. The video, released by Mehr news agency, shows Khamenei appearing healthy. This comes after Israeli media reported that Khamenei had been hospitalized in critical condition. Khamenei has not been seen publicly since the start of the US-Iran war.
